en-US.author: Microsoft Corporation
en-US.longDescription: NuGet is the package manager for .NET. It enables developers to create, share, and consume useful .NET libraries. NuGet client tools provide the ability to produce and consume these libraries as "packages".
en-US.name: NuGet
en-US.releaseNotes:
Summary: What's New in 8.0.0
- Add dotnet nuget stage push to upload packages and symbols to a staging service - #15083
- Review package supply-chain security with Copilot from the Visual Studio Error List - #15049
- Record filtered analyzer assets in project.assets.json with opt-in RestoreEnableAnalyzerAssets for .NET 11+ projects - #6279
Breaking changes
- Add nullable annotations to the following libraries, which can introduce compiler warnings or errors in consuming projects:
  - NuGet.Resolver - #15069
  - NuGet.DependencyResolver.Core - #15060
  - NuGet.Credentials - #15012
- Replace the .NET 8 target with .NET 10 in NuGet client libraries. Retain the .NET Framework 4.7.2 target - #15062
- Warn with NU5052 for non-standard package IDs in the following pack flows:
  - Classic msbuild /t:pack and nuget.exe pack - #15013
  - SDK pack when SdkAnalysisLevel is 11.0.100 or later - #14949
Issues fixed in this release
- Add NuGet.Protocol APIs for package staging resources - #15084
- Warn when dotnet package add uses a non-standard package ID - #15076
- Remove the NUGET_DISABLE_PACKAGEID_VALIDATION escape hatch in .NET 11 - #14485
- Show vulnerability indicators for top-level packages when the selected feed is not NuGet.org - #13051
- Continue listing supported projects when a solution contains unsupported Docker Compose projects. The command still returns exit code 1 - #12520
- Prevent a null-reference error when updating a package source with dotnet nuget update source - #15094
- Preserve no-op restore on Windows when project paths differ only in letter case - #15081
- Fix package-reference read errors when listing packages after dotnet package add - #15079
- Prevent a null-reference error when opening Package Manager for solutions with many projects - #15073
- Prevent an endless Package Manager refresh loop when updating packages with Central Package Management - #15072
- Include audit-source vulnerability data in the Package Manager version list - #15071
- Make deterministic package timestamps opt-in again to preserve existing PreserveNewest behavior - #15050
- Report NU1020 when minimum publish age restrictions apply to floating versions during restore - #15035
- Configure package-source minimum publish ages and package exceptions in Visual Studio settings - #15032
- Configure minimum publish ages with --min-publish-age-hours in dotnet nuget add source and dotnet nuget update source - #15031
- Respect configured minimum publish ages when dotnet package add selects the latest package version - #15028
- Respect configured minimum publish ages in dotnet package update, including updates for vulnerable packages - #15027
- Add nuget.config settings and NuGet.Configuration APIs for minimum publish ages and package exceptions - #15026
- Close the Clear NuGet Local Resources window with the Esc key - #15020
- Use the .NET SDK root to locate certificate bundles in Native AOT applications - #14980
- Fix restore failures when a Visual Studio build starts immediately after opening a solution - #14927
- Request package-source credentials instead of proxy credentials when a package source requires authentication - #14791
- Avoid an incorrect Installed-tab vulnerability indicator when the audit source is a local path - #14724
- Improve pack output filename calculation when nuspec metadata overrides the package ID or version - #14711
- Avoid showing "no packages found" alongside vulnerable packages after opening Package Manager from Solution Explorer - #14648
- Preserve vulnerability indicators when merging local and remote package versions - #14253
- Show consistent transitive-package vulnerability information in package details and the version list - #14004
- Continue listing supported projects when a solution contains unsupported JavaScript .esproj projects. The command still returns exit code 1 - #12817
- Calculate pack output paths correctly when OutputFileNamesWithoutVersion is enabled - #12644
- Allow PackageSourceProvider.UpdatePackageSource to enable a previously disabled package source - #12008
- Reduce redundant project evaluations during pack while preserving no-build behavior - #11530
- Avoid a deadlock during credential-service initialization when the value factory needs the Visual Studio UI thread - #8248
- Support the new Copilot SDK backend for NuGet workflows in Visual Studio while retaining the legacy experience - NuGet/NuGet.Client#7698

zh-CN.longDescription: NuGet 是 .NET 的软件包管理器，让开发人员能够创建、共享和使用有用的 .NET 库。NuGet 客户端工具提供了以“包”形式生成和使用这些库的能力。
